clips.title: The story
paras: The Furlbrows flee their farm as Defias bandits carry their land grant through Elwynn Forest. Returning the deed to Farmer Furlbrow near the Westfall border preserves the couple’s claim to their stolen homestead.

Defias bandits in Elwynn carry a land deed signed by Theodore and Verna Furlbrow. A crude note on its back says they drove the elderly farmer from his property, then carried the document across the river into Elwynn to copy it and forge claims to other seized land. The note says the Furlbrows were stranded just over the border, beside the road, after their wagon broke.

The Defias have driven dozens of families from their ancestral land in Westfall. With Stormwind’s army absent and the realm’s resources strained, the Brotherhood uses force and false claims to seize the kingdom’s breadbasket. Theodore and Verna are leaving their farm for safety, but their lawful deed preserves their claim if order ever returns to the province.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This is the deed to an expanse of farmlands within Westfall. It is signed by a Theodore Furlbrow and cosigned by his wife, Verna. And on the back of the deed are hastily scrawled words:
"We leaned on Furlbrow and got his deed. Thought it might be handy if you wanted to forge one of these for your own place.
The Furlbrows won't give us trouble. Last I saw them they were on their way out of Westfall, stuck with a broken wagon."
You think the Furlbrows might want their deed back...

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have the deed to my farm?? That's good news! Some ruffians stole it days ago... I thought it was gone for good!
Please, let me have it. We're on our way out of Westfall and ain't coming back any time soon, but if we do then we'll need those papers...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Loads of thanks, friend! As I was saying, these parts aren't fit for honest folk anymore, but if things get better, then this deed will let us reclaim our land.
I don't have much to offer you, but here -- take this.
